resources.string: Connect both devices to the same network. Enable network debugging on the phone. During playback, Back or Menu opens receiver controls; arrows and OK control the phone.
Ready. Use arrows to select a control and OK to activate it.
Enter a phone address and a port between 1 and 65535.
Connecting… Accept the debugging prompt on your phone if shown.
Connected. Back during playback opens the receiver menu.
On the phone, open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code. Enter its pairing port and code here. The connection port on the previous screen is separate.
Enter a valid pairing port and six-digit code.
Your phone requires pairing with this TV. Open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code on the phone.
The phone was found, but ADB pairing failed. Keep Wireless debugging enabled, confirm both devices use the same Wi‑Fi subnet, disable VPN or guest-network isolation, then show and scan a new QR code.

Paired, but no live connection port was found. Check that both devices remain on the same Wi‑Fi subnet and that VPN, guest-network isolation, and multicast filtering are disabled. Otherwise enter the current address from the phone’s main Wireless debugging screen.
On your phone: Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with QR code. Scan here. Keep both devices on the same network.

No phone detected after the scan. Confirm both devices are on the same Wi‑Fi subnet—not a guest network—keep Wireless debugging enabled, and disable VPN, hotspot/client isolation, or multicast UDP 5353 filtering. Then show a new QR code or use a pairing code.
Paired. Finding the phone’s connection port…
Mirror your phone on this TV. Keep both devices on the same network.
Select QR code to begin. Use ↑ ↓ to choose and OK to select.
Use a code for a new phone, or an address for a phone already paired with this TV.

On your phone: Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code. Copy the complete IP address and port from that popup, then its six-digit code. After pairing, we find the connection address automatically.
On your phone: open the main Wireless debugging screen. Copy its IP address and port here. Use this screen after pairing, or for a USB-authorized connection.
Use ↑ ↓ to move between fields and buttons. Press OK to type; use keyboard Done to move on.
Enter the complete address with a colon, for example 192.168.1.20:37123.
TV display check: the circle should be round and the square equally wide and tall. This pattern is drawn on the TV; the picture setting below only affects phone mirroring.
A circle inside a square, drawn with equal pixel width and height.
Arrows move · OK taps · Back opens controls
Could not send input to phone. Check phone debugging permissions or reconnect.

Press and release a spare remote button, such as a color or playback button. Its previous phone assignment will be replaced. Arrows, OK, Back, Menu, Home, and volume remain reserved. Back cancels. Mappings apply only during phone playback in this app.
Changes apply the next time you connect. During playback, use the receiver menu for live picture controls.
During playback, press Back or Menu for receiver controls. Arrows and OK control your phone.
Waiting for your phone to scan the code…
